questions.old_question: Which public admission endpoint preserves the caller-supplied key through SSH and HTTP wrappers?
questions.answer: Authenticated machine LiveView forwards caller request_key into Compute.provision. SSH request-id pins an outer SSH.Request receipt, but the first SSH execution generates a separate Compute key; repository launch derives actor/source/visit key. No generic HTTP JSON admission route was found.
questions.proposed_catalog_edit: Remove endpoint question; use the authenticated LiveView form for direct caller-supplied Compute key replay. Name SSH receipt replay as a separate contract, not evidence that its caller request-id survives in Compute.

questions.old_question: What bounded TCG/native deletion history reaches archived state without bypassing physical cleanup?
questions.answer: Native fleet lifecycle scenario drives stop/delete, waits for archived_at, released holds, removed VMM unit/ZFS dataset/rootfs and pool allocation. Hosted TCG equivalent and post-archive key replay are not built.
questions.proposed_catalog_edit: Tag partial; use native physical-cleanup sequence or equivalent hosted TCG path before end-to-end archived replay claim.
